Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: Synastry
Description: A Penumbra animation launcher for organizing, pairing, and synchronizing multi-actor animations.
Changelog: Freshly installed animation mods now activate without a manual Penumbra toggle. Group animations play once and run lobby-only EmoteSync six seconds later. Adds manual EmoteSync, Simple Heels Temp Offset, and Livepose controls.
